rappel_detail.station: The summit block, about 100 ft high, at the top of the ridge.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel: off the West Face on a single 50 m rope (about 25 m doubled), then class 3 downclimbing below it. With a 60 m rope, two rappels off the North Face instead. The standard descent then follows the Blue Glacier route and does not rappel the ridge.

set.rappels: One rappel off the summit block: down the West Face on a single 50 m rope with class 3 downclimbing below (or two off the North Face with a 60 m rope). The ridge itself is not rappelled; there are no fixed stations on it.
